description: Approves the proposal of a settings_proposal or email_send_proposal reply, as its Approve button in the app's chat does: Rollstack makes the change, or sends the email. Only approve what the user approved after seeing the reply's proposal. Answers the reply with the proposal's status: applied once the change is made, and queued for a send, which getReportMessage then follows through sending to sent, partially_sent, failed or unconfirmed, with its counts. Needs also slide_decks:email for an email change or send, and slide_decks:write for the rest. Approving a send answers 409 while the report is updating, such as after a filter change the same message asked for, and counts against the 5 email sends a minute, as sendReportEmail does. Only the user who sent the message may, while they can edit the report. A proposal already decided answers 409. From an AI client, approving a send only asks the user to confirm it in Rollstack: it answers `confirmation-required` and runs once they confirm.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

messageId.description: The message to the slides agent: the `messageId` that `sendReportMessage` returned. Only the user who sent the message can read, cancel or decide its proposals, and only while they can edit the report.

replyId.description: The reply that makes the proposal: the `id` of a `settings_proposal` or `email_send_proposal` reply that `getReportMessage` lists for the message.

name: approveReportMessageProposal
title: Approve slides agent proposal
